mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, display_title, icon_key, latest_version, source, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skills ( uuid, external_id, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, display_title, icon_key, latest_version, source, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.DisplayTitle}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{params.IconKey}, ''), 'blocks'), #{params.LatestVersion}, 'custom', #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT external_id, name FROM agents WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(skills) AS s WHERE s->>'type' = 'custom' AND s->>'skill_id' = #{externalID} ) OR ( multiagent IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(multiagent->'predefined_agents') = 'array' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(multiagent->'predefined_agents') AS pa WHERE jsonb_typeof(pa->'skills') = 'array' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(pa->'skills') AS pas WHERE pas->>'type' = 'custom' AND pas->>'skill_id' = #{externalID} ) ) ) ) ORDER BY updated_at DESC, uuid DESC

SELECT
FROM skills WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND latest_version IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE skills SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{skillUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING
UPDATE skills SET icon_key = #{iconKey}, updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND source = 'custom' AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING
